Question: An object moves \(8\) cm in a straight line from \(A\) to \(B,\) turns at an angle \(\alpha,\) measured in radians and chosen at random from the interval \((0, \pi),\) and moves \(5\) cm in a straight line to \(C.\) What is the probability that \(AC \lt 7?\)
